idea-plugin.name: Motadata Runtime Governance (MVP)
idea-plugin.description:
M3.4 IDE Plugin Integration — Runtime-governed JetBrains plugin.
Routes all governed IDE actions through the runtime Plan-Gate: - VCS commit interception (shadow/enforcing modes) - Ask / Explain / Plan (PLAN ONLY, no execution) - Submit to Runtime (governed execution request)
Surfaces distinct governance outcomes: REFUSED, DEFERRED, BOUNDED_ALLOW, BLOCKED, EXECUTED
No IDE action of interest bypasses runtime governance. Fails closed when runtime unavailable in enforcing mode.
Git Integration (Git4Idea) is optional: install JetBrains "Git" if you want the standard Git commit UI to register the check-in handler; Ask / Submit to Runtime work without it.

action.description: PLAN ONLY — governed Ask through the runtime Plan-Gate (no execution).
Submit an execution intent through the governed runtime (Plan-Gate → sandbox if allowed).
